title: Digital Image Explorer
objective: Pixels, RGB channels, grayscale images, image dimensions, bit depth, histograms.
prerequisites_original: No machine learning knowledge or dataset is required. The notebook introduces indexing, variables, arrays, and functions as they appear. Use Python 3.11 or 3.12, a terminal, and NumPy, Matplotlib, and Pillow. JupyterLab is needed only for interactive notebook use. The headless runner needs only the three image libraries plus the Python standard library. CPU execution is sufficient.
implementation_status: preserved implementation; 10 tests and real kernel passed; mastery unassessed
